name: Unleash
description: Unleash is an open-source feature flag management platform. It lets teams turn features on and off without a deploy, roll them out gradually with activation strategies, constraints and segments, and run A/B tests with variants. SDKs for many languages evaluate flags locally against the Unleash API.

notes.text: Sign in with UNLEASH_DEFAULT_ADMIN_USERNAME and UNLEASH_DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD from /opt/unleash_data/.env.
Invite and password-reset links use UNLEASH_URL in /opt/unleash_data/.env; change it when Unleash is reached through a domain.
